//: Used in: app/(app)/shares/create/tag/index.tsx (createShareTag namespace). Shown when a created share is rejected because the story didn't clearly tag the business (error 4100). Friendly guidance, not a scolding.
heading: Your story needs to mention {{business}}
body: We couldn't find the business tagged in your story. Make sure it shows one of these:
noTags: Make sure your story clearly shows the business's name or Instagram, then share a new story.
tipBody: Try making the tag bigger and post the story again. This is usually enough.
